summary.en: MiniJAM Stage-1 infrastructure and client generation delivered.
summary.zh-CN: MiniJAM Stage-1 基础设施与客户端生成已交付。

summary.en: Language, toolchain, runtime integration, deployment flow, and backend delivered.
summary.zh-CN: 语言、工具链、运行时集成、部署流程与后端已形成并交付。

summary.en: A user-facing JAM Computer application and product outcome delivered.
summary.zh-CN: 面向用户的 JAM Computer 应用与产品成果已交付。

summary.en: Continuous-learning research system, experimental model architecture, and reproducible MiniCells research tooling delivered.
summary.zh-CN: 持续学习研究系统、实验性模型架构与可复现的 MiniCells 研究工具已形成。

summary.en: The initial ZK direction was investigated and discontinued after feasibility work.
summary.zh-CN: 初始 ZK 方向经过可行性研究后停止，作为研究历史保留。

summary.en: Move JamScript toward a usable MiniJAM/JAM application-development ecosystem.
summary.zh-CN: 推动 JamScript 走向可用的 MiniJAM/JAM 应用开发生态。

summary.en: Advance reproducible continuous-learning research toward a network-usable AI service architecture.
summary.zh-CN: 推动可复现的持续学习研究走向可在网络中使用的 AI 服务架构。

summary.en: Advance Stage-1 infrastructure toward a public-resource execution network.
summary.zh-CN: 推动 Stage-1 基础设施，建设公共资源执行网络。

summary.en: Develop wallet-agnostic ownership and asset interaction primitives.
summary.zh-CN: 开发钱包无关的所有权和资产交互原语。

summary.en: Make MINI the protocol settlement asset for application and public-resource usage.
summary.zh-CN: 使 MINI 成为应用与公共资源使用的协议结算资产。

summary.en: Improve documentation, SDKs, tooling, infrastructure, and third-party application development.
summary.zh-CN: 改进文档、SDK、工具链、基础设施和第三方应用开发路径。
